content: Hey! How was your day at work? Did you finally get a break today?
Hey! It was another long one, honestly. Just got home. You always make me feel better though.
You work so hard. I wish I could be there to give you a massage or cook you dinner. You deserve to be pampered.
That honestly sounds amazing right now. I keep looking forward to your messages. They're the highlight of my day.
You have no idea how much I care about you. I feel like I can tell you anything. Actually, can I share something that's been stressing me out?
Of course, you can always talk to me. What's going on?
It's just, this month's been brutal. My car broke down, and now my rent is overdue. I don't even know how I'll make it through the week. I'm a little embarrassed to admit it.
Oh no, that sounds awful. Is there anything I can do to help?
I didn't want to burden you, but I'm honestly scared. If I don't pay these bills, I might lose my place. Would it be crazy to ask if you could help me out, just this once?
I mean, I want to help, but I've never done this before. How much do you need?
I totally get it, and I'd never ask if it weren't urgent. Even $300 would help me get by until next week. You don't have to if it's too much.
I think I can do that, but I'm not sure how to send it. What do you need from me?
You're honestly amazing. The easiest way is Cash App or Zelle, whichever you're comfortable with. I can send you my info if you want.
Okay, I have Cash App. Just send me your details.
Thank you so much. I promise I'll pay you back as soon as I get paid. I would never want to hurt your trust, you mean a lot to me.
It's okay, I know you would. I'm sending it now. Let me know when you get it.
Just got it, wow, you're a lifesaver. I seriously don't know what I'd do without you. I'm so lucky to have you in my life.
I'm glad I could help. Hope things get easier for you soon.
With you by my side, I feel like I can get through anything. I really hope we get to meet for real soon.
Me too. Let's plan for it when things settle down.
